title: Learning Content Producer
abolSummaryText: Learning Content Producer is a contractor role with Abol Learn Studio in Nairobi, Kenya. Pay is 45 USD per hour; apply by 15 January 2027.
description:
Turn short technical explainers into calm, captioned lessons.

You will:
- Brief video clips and write plain-language summaries
- Keep resource lists easy to scan on mobile
- Coordinate caption review for English and Ethiopian languages

Nice to have: experience with curriculum writing or community learning programs.
